top_concerns: Only baseline is plain CE on the full noisy data; no comparison to any noisy-label learning method, early stopping, or same-IPC subset selection
No new method: an empirical benchmark of off-the-shelf distillers, with failure modes (asymmetric noise, IPC choice) left unaddressed
Corollaries I and II are unproven, loosely defined (delta and assumptions unspecified) and not validated empirically
Privacy, efficiency, 'in the wild' and imbalanced-data claims are asserted without experiments (no Clothing1M/WebVision, no cost or privacy analysis)
Evaluation protocol unclear (test-set use for selection, seeds, baseline parity); results given only as curves with no tables or variances
